counting_note: Minimum distinct outcome inventory, not a provider-request count or an exhaustive historical count. Twenty-three public outcomes are crosswalked to recovered launches before eight distinct additional outcomes are admitted. Source reads, repeats of saved results, help/version/authentication preparation and offline tests are inventoried separately rather than counted as new model/MCP attempts. Quarantined or redacted records cannot establish the absence of earlier or additional attempts.
timing_note: Telemetry intervals, observation instants and completion instants are distinct. Command envelopes and granular usage stay private. Full active duration, billing, Codex allocation and human time are unavailable, not zero.

discrepancies: Existing C01 is not the earliest publicly documented Claude attempt: PC01 and PC02 are distinct 20 August attempts, followed by exploratory PC03.
Existing C06 is not the first HOST-002 model-task observation: PC12 and PC13 precede it, and PC11 is an earlier authentication preflight stop.
Existing C07 omits an earlier successful one-call result withheld solely for reported num_turns 3 (PC15); PC16 is the fresh post-fix accepted run.

Existing C08 is the third documented exact-five attempt, not the first. Historical runbook d2f3e72 records two earlier four-call failures (PC17 and PC18). Commit 5645c84 explicitly calls the eight-turn run the fourth observation.
Existing C07 and C12 started_at_utc values are execution completion times: each verifier derives observed_at from manifest.execution.finished_at. Move them to completed_at_utc.
Existing C01 observed_at is a public observation instant with no proved start/end meaning. Preserve it separately; do not silently label it a launch time.

The public envelope is 2026-08-20T18:12:18.064Z to the accepted exact-five completion at 2026-08-27T20:55:58.173Z: 7 days 2 hours 43 minutes 40.109 seconds, not effort or cumulative model execution time.
The original three-day window remains a valid interval between its chosen instants but is incorrectly described as starting at the earliest precisely timed retained observation.
The causal table omits the constructor fallback (#40), composite transport/lifecycle work (#63/#64), identity repair (#68), exact-five verifier and six-to-seven-turn/prompt correction (#82).
Collision rejection and standards-aligned naming were added in #74; #73 established the permission alias. Avoid attributing both changes solely to #73.
The duplicate JSON/CSV links in CLAUDE_RETROSPECTIVE.md lines 23-27 are an editorial duplication.
Metadata compatibility was changed in #74, but reviewed public prose does not independently establish a distinct preceding observation count; leave it uncounted pending primary reconciliation.
The first 12-row edition omitted eleven publicly documented outcomes; private recovery supplies eight additional distinct outcome rows after crosswalking, not by adding raw candidate counts.
The ten-launch initial recovery addendum omitted six launches whose executable names had been redacted but other arguments and results remained; the completed review uses those corroborating fields.
One ten-turn exit-2 launch is not equated with the subsequent four-call normal-completion observation. Its exact failing boundary and model contact remain unresolved.
One saved SDK result read is not a new model invocation and is excluded from the four directly paired SDK-result totals; its attribution to another launch is unproven.
The two earlier exact-five launches reconcile to the public pair as a set; their individual public outcome identity is not established by the public summary.
The first retained public probe is anchored, but neither it nor a corpus search proves the first-ever informal attempt. Full attempt count remains unknown.
